title: Asia session characteristics predict London session behavior
problem_statement: The characteristics of the Asian session contain predictive information about the subsequent London session's behavior for XAU/USD (direction and return).
mathematical_formulation: Let F_Asia(t) be a feature vector computed only from bars with timestamps in the Asia session window ending at t*. Let y_dir = 1{Close_London > Open_London} and y_ret = (Close_London - Open_London) / Open_London. H0: IC(F_Asia, y) = 0 and out-of-sample predictive metrics are indistinguishable from noise after multiple-testing adjustment. H1: there exists a measurable predictive relationship under purged CV and walk-forward validation.
author: RIDGE DELA TORJAGBO
